q: Which parts of the shoe can be replaced?
a: Three modules come off the chassis: the outsole, the upper and the insole. Each is sold separately in every colour and size. The chassis itself is covered by a 5-year warranty and is replaced free if it ever fails.

q: How do I swap a module?
a: Every RE:RUN One ships with a module key. The outsole twist-locks at six points; turn the key a quarter turn at each point and lift. The upper rides a hook-and-loop rail with a front lock; release the lock and peel. The insole lifts straight out. First swap takes about five minutes — see our step-by-step guide in the Journal.

q: How do I find my size?
a: RE:RUN One runs true to size in US unisex sizing. If you are between sizes, go up half a size. Modules use the same size as your chassis. A printable size chart is on the Shipping & Returns page.

q: Is RE:RUN One a road or trail shoe?
a: The standard outsole is tuned for road and light gravel. A lug outsole module for trail is in development for 2027.

q: How does the return-credit loop work?
a: Order a replacement module, pack the worn one in the prepaid mailer that comes with every module order and drop it at any post office. Once it reaches the Repair Lab we credit your account: $12 for an outsole, $18 for an upper, $6 for an insole. Credit never expires.

q: Will replacement modules be sold separately?
a: Yes. Outsole ($59), upper ($79) and insole ($29) modules are all available now in every colour and size, with or without a complete sneaker order.

q: What happens to the modules I send back?
a: Rubber outsoles are ground and remoulded into new outsoles. Uppers are shredded into fibre for insole top cloth. Insoles are composted at our partner facility in Dong Nai.

Every pair has a unique ID printed under the tongue and on your passport card. Scan it in the RE:RUN app or on your account page to see purchase date, each module's install date and estimated kilometres, warranty status and repair history. When you sell the pair on, the passport transfers to the new owner.

q: Do I need the app to use the shoe?
a: No. The passport is optional. It is useful for warranty claims and resale, but the shoe works without it.
Standard shipping is 5–7 business days, Express 2–3 days, International 7–14 days. Orders placed before 2:00 PM local hub time ship the same day from Ho Chi Minh City or Los Angeles.
Standard shipping is free on all orders over $99. Below that it is $8. Express is $18 and International $25 regardless of order value.

q: Do you ship to my country?
a: We ship to 42 countries across Asia-Pacific, North America and the EU. Duties and taxes for international orders are calculated at checkout so there are no surprises on delivery.

q: Which payment methods do you accept?
a: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and MoMo or VNPay for customers in Vietnam. All prices are in US dollars.

q: Can I change or cancel my order?
a: Yes, within 2 hours of placing it. Email support@rerun.run with your order number and we will sort it out.

q: How do I track my order?
a: You receive a tracking link by email the moment your parcel leaves the hub. You can also see it under Track Order on your account page.

30-day free returns on unworn complete sneakers and unopened modules. Worn modules are not returned for refund — they go into the return-credit loop instead. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of receipt.

The chassis is covered for 5 years against structural failure. Modules are covered for 12 months against manufacturing defects. Normal wear of the outsole tread, upper knit or insole foam is not a defect — that is what modules are for.

q: Can I buy RE:RUN One now?
a: Yes. RE:RUN One and all modules are in stock and ship within 1–2 business days.
